name: Rápido y jarioso, beef finish
for: beef ribs, trisket (tri-tip cooked like a brisket), burnt ends, brisket, pulled pork
notes: Hector 10-28, confirmed: rápido at 250 with the 185 bark check, then at 197 wrap in butcher paper with beef tallow and off the smoker to rest. Cook done: the pit drops to 150, the rest to 160-155, then the hold.

pit.name: Rápido
pit.tell: Rápido y jarioso: pit at 250 the whole way.

meat.name: Point of interest
meat.tell: {meat}°F, the point of interest: check the bark. Keep going to 197.

meat.name: Wrap
meat.tell: Meat {meat}°F: wrap it in butcher paper with beef tallow and take it off to rest. Tap Cook done: the pit drops to 150 for the hold.
